ac1d04f30396cb41.description:
What We Do
Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.
Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.
We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are
Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.
The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.
Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.
Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need
As an Account Executive at Rillet, you’ll be at the forefront of transforming how high-growth companies run their finances. Your mission is to drive revenue growth by building deep, strategic relationships with CFOs, finance leaders, and accounting teams — helping them realize the full potential of Rillet. You’ll work with everything from fast-scaling startups to global enterprises, tailoring your approach and refining your craft along the way.
This role blends business acumen, strategic sales expertise, and a strong grasp of AI-powered automation — empowering the world’s most ambitious companies to achieve zero-day close and operate with real-time financial clarity.
We’re primarily looking for teammates within commutable distance of our New York City or San Francisco offices, or those willing to relocate. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States.
Office-based team members work in person Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day. Certain roles may require more in-office time based on the needs of the function.

What You'll Do
• 
Build the GTM playbook
You’ll play a key role in building the playbook and driving our GTM motion. Specifically, you’ll refine our process playbook, run message tests, perform ROI comparison analyses, experiment to find new and unexpected channels, and more. You’ll take full ownership with a scrappy approach and double down when you see signs of success.
• 
Execute relentlessly
Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to founders and product teams in near real-time. Perform strategic, personalized outreach to priority accounts and drive opportunities forward from SQL to signed deal. You’ll roll up your sleeves and accelerate velocity.
• 
Represent Rillet
You’ll be the face of the company — applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is exceptional. You’re comfortable selling to users with deep finance and accounting expertise and will deepen your domain knowledge in the process.

Who We're Looking For
• 
4–5+ years of AE experience at a top-tier SaaS startup, with a track record of driving complex, multi-threaded deals from discovery to close.
• 
Exceptional communicator and relationship builder who simplifies complex concepts, earns executive sponsorship, and champions customer success.
• 
Proactive self-starter who hustles, drives initiatives beyond core responsibilities, and thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
• 
Trusted product expert and customer advocate who guides clients through evaluations, deployments, and adoption of AI solutions.
• 
Strategic operator who builds pipeline, quantifies business value, and drives measurable ROI for clients.
• 
Detail-oriented collaborator who delivers actionable feedback to internal teams to improve product and process outcomes.

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:
Tier A: OTE $240,000 – $280,000
Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.
Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.
 
Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet
• 
Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.
• 
Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.
• 
Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.
• 
Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.
Compensation: $240K – $280K • Offers Equity
• Zone A • OTE $240K – $280K • Offers Equity

About Us

Oxane Partners is a technology-driven solutions provider to the private credit markets. Our solutions transform the way investment firms and banks analyze and manage their investments. We unify our technology with deep domain expertise to provide compelling and relevant solutions across all asset classes. Our collaborative engagement approach helps our clients evaluate more opportunities faster and better manage their existing investments while still maintaining the rigor of their investment process. Our solutions manage over $800 billion of notional for 100+ clients including 20 of the top 30 global investment banks, 10 of the top 15 global private credit investment firms, 5 of the top 10 global private equity firms, and 10 of the top 25 alternative asset managers. Founded in 2014 by former credit traders from Deutsche Bank, Oxane Partners has grown to a team of 600+ highly skilled financial analysts and technology experts. Oxane Partners is headquartered in London and has additional offices in New York, Gurgaon, and Hyderabad.

Senior Analyst – FP&A will assist in preparing budgets and forecasts, perform variance analysis of actuals versus plan, and support in financial performance reviews. The role focuses on analysing trends, providing actionable insights, supporting planning and decision-making processes while working closely with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in preparation of annual budgets, periodic forecasts and recurring FP&A schedules. 
• Perform actuals vs. budget/forecast variance analysis and highlight key drivers with supporting data. 
• Assist in preparing monthly reports, dashboards and presentations for management review. 
• Assist in developing and maintaining financial models, and ad-hoc analysis files. 
• Collaborate with business teams to gather inputs, understand business drivers, validate assumptions and reconcile data. 
• Contribute to process improvement, automation and standardisation of FP&A reporting, dashboards and planning templates. 
• Ensure accuracy of FP&A outputs and alignment with accounting principles, internal controls and financial reporting requirements. 

Requirements

• Strong proficiency in Advanced Excel, including lookups, logical formulas, pivot tables, and advanced analytical functions, along with strong working knowledge of MS PowerPoint and MS Word. 
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret financial and operational data, identify trends, and highlight key business drivers. 
• Good understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, accruals, variance analysis and management reporting. 
• Ability to prepare clear reports and present financial insights concisely to finance and business stakeholders. 
• High attention to detail, ownership mindset, process orientation and ability to manage recurring reporting timelines with accuracy. 
• Good communication and stakeholder management skills. 
• Candidate should be comfortable working in a growing FP&A setup with evolving processes and high expectations on accuracy and turnaround time. 
• Exposure to Power BI, ERP systems, or automation tools will be an added advantage.

Key responsibilities: 

1. Own software projects across the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through development, deployment, and maintenance. 
2. Build both complete software-only solutions and hardware-adjacent software systems that interact with in-house hardware, embedded devices, and other physical systems. 
3. Break down ambiguous problems and turn them into practical, maintainable technical solutions. 
4. Design system architecture and make technology decisions appropriate to the problem being solved. 
5. Develop across different layers of the technology stack depending on project requirements. 
6. Build applications, backend services, APIs, SDKs, algorithms, integrations, and supporting infrastructure. 
7. Develop software that communicates with and interfaces with hardware and embedded systems. 
8. Work with databases, cloud services, data processing, and synchronization systems. 
9. Deploy and operate software in production, primarily using AWS. 
10. Handle DevOps responsibilities including infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, authentication, security, and scaling. 
11. Design software as well-structured, maintainable modules with clear interfaces and responsibilities. 
12. Test, debug, optimize, and maintain systems throughout their lifecycle. 
13. Investigate and solve problems across the entire system rather than being limited to a single layer. 
14. Learn and adopt new languages, frameworks, libraries, protocols, tools, and technologies as projects require. 
15. Work independently and take responsibility for the reliability, quality, and performance of the systems you build. 

This is an entry-level position, so we are not expecting extensive industry experience. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.

DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!

The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 

While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.

This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.

Basic Qualifications:
• Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
• Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
• Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
• Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
• Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
• Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
• Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
• Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
• US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
• Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
• Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
• Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
• Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows

Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Marketing Analyst.

About the job

We're hiring a Senior Marketing Analyst to join our global marketing analytics team, sitting alongside our regional analytics business partners (EMEA and APJ). This position is needed to help fuel insights to our International Marketing teams. You will be responsible for analytics across our B2B and B2C funnels, diving into our Marketing engine that powers developers across the world who use and love Twilio products, as well as surfacing high potential opportunities for our Sales teams.  You will be part of a highly visible Analytics team that serves as the trusted advisor to our regional VPs of Marketing.  You will get to work with great minds across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Finance.  A truly horizontal role and opportunity to build strong relationships!

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Analysis & Insight: Dive deep into marketing performance data across the EMEA region, identifying trends, successes, and areas for improvement. Your analyses will form the backbone of our strategic marketing decisions, enabling us to sharpen our focus and optimize our approaches.
  • Strategic Guidance: Provide evidence-based recommendations to the VP of Marketing and the broader marketing organization. Your insights will inform adjustments in our marketing strategies, ensuring they are aligned with our regional revenue goals and broader company objectives.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales strategy and analytics, global marketing, and customer engagement teams to ensure a cohesive and integrated approach to market analysis and strategy implementation. As a bridge between data and strategy, your role will be pivotal in fostering internal solid partnerships.
  • Innovation & Optimisation: Champion using advanced analytics, marketing technologies, and data-driven insights to fuel innovation within our marketing practices. Your forward-thinking mindset will contribute to our continuous quest for excellence in customer engagement.
  • Reporting & Communication: Craft and deliver compelling presentations and reports that distill complex data into clear, actionable insights. Your ability to communicate effectively across different levels of the organization will ensure that insights lead to action.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • At least 5 years of analytical experience with fluency in analytics tools (e.g. Python, Looker, SQL, Tableau)
  • 3+ years of experience leveraging data to uncover insights, and communicating to leadership teams to influence business strategy
  • A collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional teams and is adept at building relationships across diverse groups.
  • Creative and strategic thinker with a passion for leveraging data to drive innovation and improvement in marketing practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Statistics, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications in analytics, data science, or similar fields will be highly regarded.
  • Experience working on or with AI products (e.g., LLMs, copilots, RAG apps, workflow tools).

Desired:

  • Prior direct experience building or co-building an MMM model, or working as an embedded analytics partner to an MMM/data science team.
  • Prior experience in B2B marketing analytics, consulting, or an agency environment.
  • Experience working across multiple regions or in a global, matrixed organization. 

Location

 This role will be remote, and based in India (Karnataka, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Delhi).

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

. …
